function shift223() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New223; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old223 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New223 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic223 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old223)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old223; $owner=new Magic223; $result=$owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable(new InvokeChild223))($argument,shift223())); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

$owner=new MagicZero223; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(1,(\Closure::fromCallable(new Zero223))()); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
